title: My Brother Forged My Share Of The Bindery, Handing Me A $4,200 Store Credit. So I Said Nothing
description: I cashed out my $115k 401(k) to open a leather journal bindery with my brother, only for him to forge a buyout, sell the studio for $690K, and hand me a $4,200 bookstore credit. I retrieved our original notarized agreement from a hidden pocket in his wedding journal and proved the forgery. Now he works in my shop, Bound by Fraud Books, wearing a shirt that says 'Spilled Ink on Trust,' while every journal carries his perjury case number. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #BoundByFraudBooks
thumb_text: NOW HE WEARS SPILLED INK ON TRUST IN MY SHOP
pinned_comment: If your brother forged your share of a bindery, handed you a $4,200 bookstore credit, and you found the real agreement hidden in his wedding journal, what would you have done? Share your story in the comments.
